svg.title: Flow: registering a team of three (team captain, teammates)
svg.text: 04 · Flow: registering a team of three (team captain, teammates)
Use case: in a teams season, Demo Player names a team, invites two friends with a link or a QR, and the team is in when the third joins

g.text: The team holds your place now; it counts once

svg.text: 1 · Name the team
Name rules as the legacy's (24
characters, unique in the season). The
captain is the one who made it.
2 · Invite
A QR at the table, a link in chat, or a short
code for Discord. The invite ends when
the team is full or the season starts.
scan
3 · A teammate joins
Signed in and a member of the event, one
tap. A friend without an account is added
by the crew as a guest (U5).
4 · Full
Until the start the captain renames, swaps
a player or withdraws. After the start,
swaps are the crew's (live swap).

g.text: The season starts in 10 minutes. A team
Fills the place with the first solo sign-up, if

svg.text: 5 · Short at the start
A team still short at the start is left out,
or filled from the solo list when the
season takes both (U3, U4).
Why invites

The legacy's teams mode let one browser register three nicknames, and only that browser could report. Here every player is a person: each joins with their own sign-in, so each can see the match and report from their own phone (U4, U7).
